concept: Max and his friends get lost in the woods
hook: Max accidentally leaves his favorite snack behind
setup: Max tries to find his way back home, but keeps getting distracted by silly things he finds in the woods
escalation: As night falls, Max's friends join him on an adventure to find a way out of the forest before it gets too dark
ending: They finally find their way out, exhausted but relieved, and share a laugh about their wild adventure
